extDescription.message: Blur or cover any part of a video or web page. Hide chat, names, prices or personal details before your stream sees them.

shapeElement.message: Click an element to cover it (scroll = larger or smaller element)

pick.message: Pick a color from the page (scroll = larger or smaller area)

anchorVideoTitle.message: Scales and moves with the video picture, also in theater mode and fullscreen

anchorElementTitle.message: Moves along with the part of the page underneath, also when you scroll

anchorPageTitle.message: Stays in the same place in the browser window

presetTitle.message: Add the shapes of a saved preset to this page

presetSaveTitle.message: Keep the shapes on this page as a preset, so you can add them to other pages later

clearAllTitle.message: Remove all shapes on this page

overviewTitle.message: See all saved shapes per site

hideShape.message: Switch this shape off: keep it, but hide nothing (H)

hintDraw.message: Drag to draw, click a shape to select it. Shift = square or circle. Alt + drag = draw on top of another shape. Enter = save, Esc = cancel.

hintEdit.message: Drag the shape to move it, drag the corners to resize. Arrows = nudge 1px (Shift = 10px). H = switch off or on. Delete = remove. Esc = deselect.

hintOff.message: This shape is switched off: it's kept, but hides nothing. H = switch it back on.

hintNoVideo.message: No video found: new shapes stick to the window.

hintPick.message: Click a part of the page to cover it; the shape scrolls along with it. Scroll = select the surrounding element, or go back. Alt + click = pick underneath an existing shape. Enter = save, Esc = cancel.

hintMissing.message: Some shapes are hidden because their element isn't on this page right now.

optionsSub.message: All saved shapes, per site. Page applies to one video, Section to everything under the first part of the address, Whole site to the entire site.

optionsEmpty.message: No saved shapes yet. Click the VOD Blur icon on a page to draw one.

exportTitle.message: Download all shapes and presets as a file, as a backup or to move them to another browser

importTitle.message: Add shapes and presets from an exported file. What you already have is kept.

importFailed.message: That file isn't a VOD Blur export.
